newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan's Al-Ghazi Tractor up 3.81 pct.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan's Al-Ghazi Tractor up 3.81 pct.

text.p: Pakistan's Al-Ghazi Tractor rose 1.10 rupees, or 3.81 percent, to 30 on Friday after the government announced moves to promote locally manufactured tractors and boost the agriculture sector, dealers said.
Some 5,500 shares of the stock changed hands in the first 90 minutes of the special session to concide with Finance Minister Sartaz Aziz's budget speech for the fiscal 1997/98 (July-June).
"The news has boosted Al-Ghazi shares," dealer Zaina Nowsherwan said. -- Karachi newsroom 9221-5685192
